title: Opening and Lewis's brief lessons with Sidney Bechet
summary: Lewis introduces himself in New Orleans to visit Bill Russell. He was one of Bechet's two pupils, taking about eight lessons starting in 1947.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: Well, this is Robert Lewis. I've come down to New Orleans to visit Bill Russell.
I understand you were one of the two pupils that Sidney Bechet had, and I hope you could tell us a little bit about your lessons with him and your experiences with Sidney.

Well, I guess I was one of his pupils, but not for very long. I was going to school at the time, and of course he was traveling a great deal. And I suppose I took no more than eight lessons in total from him.
